_: Catalog of actions a card may carry. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: the agent that writes content picks an `id` and fills `params`; the build script computes the artifact's mcp manifest from the actions the feed actually used. The agent CANNOT invent a call: (server, tool) must be in the manifest declared at publish time, or the call fails with not_in_manifest. Labels here are English defaults; a repo in another language keeps its own copy of this file beside the library.

kinds.link: renders a real <a>, never a button. invariant: window.open is BLOCKED in the artifact's sandboxed frame and fails silently, which is exactly how the first version shipped links that did nothing (2026-09-18). An anchor navigates; a script does not. The page records `clicked` and nothing more, because it cannot see what happened in the new tab.
kinds.mcp: calls one of the owner's claude.ai connectors with the owner's credentials. Records `done` or `error` with the code.

rules: A tap on an action counts as the owner's approval for that one action and nothing else.
Anything that leaves the machine or cannot be undone carries `confirm: true` and needs a second tap.
An action is offered only when the card actually has the data it needs. No greyed-out buttons.
Errors are shown per card with the fix for that code, never as one banner.
Writing to the base is NOT an action. That is Claude's job in the morning, from what the diary and the answers say; a button for it would only move typing from one place to another.

open.label: open
open.when: A listing, a document, a page. Anything on the web.

open-mail.label: open message
open-mail.when: A card that came from a message, so the whole thread is one tap away.

open-artifact.label: open artifact
open-artifact.when: Another artifact of the same repo.

call.label: call
call.when: A card whose next move is a phone call: a seller, an office, a clinic.

sms.label: message
sms.when: Same as `call`, when a written line is enough.

mail-to.label: write email
mail-to.when: Writing to someone who is not already in a thread; opens the owner's own mail app with the text filled in.

map.label: on the map
map.when: A plot, an address, a meeting point.

draft-reply.label: draft reply
draft-reply.when: The reply is known but the owner wants to read it before it goes. The default for mail.

send-reply.label: send reply
send-reply.when: A short answer that only the owner can give and that has no reason to wait. Leaves the machine, so it asks twice.

archive-mail.label: archive
archive-mail.when: The message was read here and does not need the inbox any more.

label-mail.label: label
label-mail.when: The sender belongs to a label the map already knows.

trash-mail.label: trash
trash-mail.when: Only for what is certainly junk. Destructive, so it asks twice.

schedule.label: schedule
schedule.when: A card with a deadline where a slot in the calendar is what actually moves it.
